prose:
A Bloomberg item indexed by Techmeme says Sierra is finalizing a round exceeding $1.75 billion led by Lightspeed and Greenoaks at a $30 billion valuation. The feed compares that with a $15.8 billion valuation in May and frames the company around customer-service AI.

The primary read exposed only the headline, so investor commitments, timing and final terms were not inspected. Finalizing is not a closed financing and valuation is not cash received, revenue or profitability. A separate founder interview is not a substitute for transaction documents. The figures remain attributed feed reporting.
highlights: Lightspeed and Greenoaks are named as leads
Primary access exposed only a headline
Valuation is distinct from funding received or revenue
